summary: Results-driven Full Stack Developer with 6 years of experience developing scalable, secure, and high-performance web applications across banking and manufacturing domains. Proficient in React.js, Angular, Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, SQL, Node.js, and .NET, with strong expertise in microservices architecture, RESTful API development, and database optimization. Skilled at translating complex business requirements into efficient, maintainable, and user-centric solutions while ensuring data integrity, regulatory compliance, and a seamless user experience. Known for collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams to deliver robust, enterprise-grade software that drives operational efficiency and supports digital innovation.

jobs.role: Software Engineer with Cognizant Technology Solutions
bullets: Designed and developed scalable full-stack applications using Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, Angular, React.js, and SQL.
Built responsive, component-driven UIs in Angular and React.js, leveraging modular architecture and optimized state management (Redux, Context API).
Developed dynamic dashboards, data-visualization modules, and interactive forms to enhance user experience and usability.
Engineered secure, high-performance RESTful APIs and microservices using Spring Boot and Node.js, ensuring scalability and maintainability.
Integrated internal and third-party services using REST, JSON, OAuth2, and JWT for seamless and secure communication.
Designed and optimized relational database schemas, queries, stored procedures, and indexes across SQL and Oracle systems.
Utilized Hibernate/JPA for efficient ORM mapping and performance tuning in data-intensive applications.
Worked within microservices architecture with containerized deployments using Docker and modular service design.
Contributed to architectural decisions aligned with SOLID principles, design patterns, and industry best practices.
Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab, and Azure DevOps for automated testing and deployments.
Managed version control and build processes using Git, Bitbucket, Maven, and Gradle.
Achieved 90%+ code coverage through comprehensive unit testing using JUnit and Mockito.
Performed API validation with Postman and conducted load/performance testing using JMeter.
Collaborated in Agile/Scrum teams, participating in stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
Partnered closely with QA, DevOps, and Product teams to deliver timely, high-quality releases.
Implemented authentication and authorization frameworks using JWT, Spring Security, and OAuth2.
Ensured compliance with security standards including HIPAA and PCI DSS in banking and healthcare projects.
Deployed applications on AWS and Azure, utilizing services such as API Gateway and cloud storage.
Configured and managed application servers including Tomcat, WebLogic, and Spring Cloud components.
Led Java 8 migration efforts and refactored legacy monolithic systems into microservices-based architectures.
Produced technical design documents, UML diagrams, sequence flows, and deployment guides.
Engaged in client discussions, requirement gathering, and solution walkthroughs.
Optimized backend queries, API performance, and front-end rendering for improved system efficiency and user experience.
